turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I don't see what's funny. Why am I here, Hale?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You've just accused my son, and so far you've shown me nothing. What do you have, Hale?
I'm sorry? Owen's essay. What do you have?
